title: Account for conversion of debt into equity

items.concept: Initial recognition of convertible debt as straight debt; straight-line subsequent measurement schedule; period-end interest and amort JEs; partial conversion settlement at carrying amount (no gain/loss); presentation of conversion feature
Number-variant twin: issue convertible bonds at a premium as straight debt; SL amort schedule; interest JEs; full conversion at carrying amount with remaining unamortized premium
Period-end/mid-period adjusting JE to update interest and amortization to conversion date; conversion settlement JE; induced conversion expense for cash sweetener; disclosure of inducement
Classification — straight-debt issuance of convertible bonds; book-value conversion (no G/L); treatment of conversion inducement
